title: 第13章 进山打猎伐木第14章 熊霸狼群
content_zh:
张昊宇犹如呵护着两颗珍贵的明珠一般，紧紧地抱着两个小不点妹妹。
父亲则犹如一座沉稳的山岳，扛着麻袋，里面装满了布匹！一家人浩浩荡荡地回到家里。
张昊宇迫不及待地问：“娘，今天有多少鱼？”
母亲喜笑颜开地，“比昨天还多呢，差不多有六百斤，换完布后，轧钢厂和罐头厂的两个采购员每人都分到了170多斤呢！”
母亲接着皱起眉头，“那几个人太可恶了，一看就不是什么好东西。
你怎么敢动手打他们？万一他们还手，你被他们打伤了怎么办？”
“娘！他们不过是几个小混混而已，他们根本打不过我的！”
父亲开口，“你少吹牛了，他们一伙有四个人呢！他们要是一起动手，咱们几个人肯定不是他们的对手！”
“爹！你不知道我会武功吗？我现在可厉害了！那几个人根本不是我的对手！”
“我知道你练过武功，你才多大，练几天武能有多厉害？”
“不相信算了！”说完，他便抱着两个小不点妹妹回到房间。
他拿出两个奶糖，轻轻地递给两个小不点妹妹，又给弟弟几块奶糖。
“小天，给你姐姐两块！”
小天乖巧地答应道：“好的，二哥！”然后拿着糖出了房间。
张昊宇保持着原身，跟父母的相处方式，孩子不愿意跟父母多说话。
甚至不愿意呆在父亲身边，这并不是张昊宇个人的行为，而是这个年代大多数家庭的写照！
因为在这个年代，大多数父母对孩子的教育方式，“非打即骂”，以管教为主。
这个年代的孩子，就像被关在笼子里的小鸟，说错话、不听话、做错事，不是挨打就是被骂一顿。
在物质方面，更是匮乏，没有零食，没有玩具，能吃饱饭就已经是最大的幸福了。
孩子就像被放养的小羊，自由自在地奔跑着，所以大多数孩子，都不愿意跟父母多待，更不愿意跟父母多说话。

不像后世，大多数父母对孩子的教育方式，以说教引导为主，宠着哄着，孩子说错话、不听话，不会挨打。
甚至做错事，只要不是故意干坏事，基本不会挨打。
物质方面，自幼便有琳琅满目的吃食，数之不尽的玩具，故而，“多数孩子”皆喜爱与父母撒娇、聊天、玩闹……
两个小丫头有东西吃便安静下来，张昊宇则躺在床上，闭上双眼，意念进入空间，苹果树、橘子树皆已长大！
他又用意念给果树浇了井水！粮食没有浇井水，还需要两天才能成熟。
蔬菜成熟后则被收进仓库，挑选一部分将种子重新种下！
神识观察仓库，看到了从黑市换来的两本书！他突然想起，自己得去书店找找书籍，学学繁体字，说干就干！
吃完午饭，张昊宇来到书店，书店既可免费看书，也可买书，若花钱办借书证，交押金还能借书！
张昊宇看了一会儿书，惊喜地发现自己竟然过目不忘。
这是灵泉水、灵液对身体改造的缘故？还是修炼“玄天长生诀”的功效？
想不明白便不再想了，反正这是件好事。
张昊宇用神识寻找自己需要的书，又有了新的发现，只要将精神力集中在一本书上！用神识扫描，便能快速将整本书的知识储存到脑海中！
张昊宇对这个能力反复试验了几次，这能力简直太棒了。
一下午便将所需的书都用神识扫描了一遍，将知识储存到脑海中，慢慢消化吧！
接下来的三天，张昊宇带着家人，分别前往护城河、一和园的湖中钓鱼，也从护城河、一和园的湖里收获了许多箱子！
content_en:
Zhang Haoyu hugged his two little sisters tightly as if he were protecting two precious pearls.
The father is like a steady mountain, carrying a sack full of cloth! The family returned home in a grand manner.
Zhang Haoyu couldn't wait to ask: "Mom, how many fish are there today?"
Mother beamed, "It's more than yesterday, almost 600 kilograms. After changing the cloth, the two buyers at the steel rolling mill and cannery each received more than 170 kilograms!"
The mother then frowned and said, "Those people are so hateful, they are not good people at first glance.
How dare you hit them? What if they fight back and you are injured by them? "
"Mom! They are just a few gangsters, they can't beat me at all!"
The father said, "Stop bragging, there are four of them in a group! If they attack together, we will definitely not be their opponents!"
"Dad! Don't you know I know martial arts? I'm so powerful now! Those people are no match for me!"
"I know you have practiced martial arts. How old are you? How good can you be after practicing martial arts for a few days?"
"Forget it if you don't believe it!" After saying that, he returned to the room with his two little sisters in his arms.
He took out two toffees and gently handed them to the two little sisters, and gave his brother a few more toffees.
"Xiaotian, give your sister two dollars!"
Xiaotian agreed obediently: "Okay, second brother!" Then he took the candy and left the room.
Zhang Haoyu maintains his original identity and the way he interacts with his parents. The child does not want to talk to his parents too much.
Even unwilling to stay with his father, this is not Zhang Haoyu's personal behavior, but a portrayal of most families in this era!
Because in this era, most parents use "beating and scolding" to educate their children, focusing on discipline.
Children in this era are like birds in a cage. If they say the wrong thing, disobey, or do something wrong, they will either be beaten or scolded.
In terms of material things, they are even more scarce. There are no snacks or toys. Being able to eat enough is already the greatest happiness.
Children are like free-range lambs, running freely, so most children are unwilling to spend more time with their parents, let alone talk to them more.
Unlike later generations, most parents' education methods for their children are mainly preaching and guidance, pampering and coaxing. Children will not be beaten if they say wrong things or are disobedient.
Even if you do something wrong, as long as you don't do bad things intentionally, you will basically not be beaten.
In terms of material things, there is a dazzling array of food and countless toys since childhood. Therefore, "most children" like to act coquettishly, chat, and play with their parents...
The two little girls calmed down when they had something to eat. Zhang Haoyu lay on the bed, closed his eyes, and entered the space with his mind. The apple and orange trees had grown up!
He watered the fruit trees with well water again with his thoughts! Without well water, the grain will take another two days to mature.
When the vegetables are mature, they are collected into the warehouse and some are selected to be replanted!
Observing the warehouse with his spiritual consciousness, he saw two books exchanged from the black market! He suddenly remembered that he had to go to the bookstore to look for books, learn traditional Chinese characters, and just do it!
After lunch, Zhang Haoyu came to the bookstore. You can read books for free in the bookstore, and you can also buy books. If you spend money to get a library card and pay a deposit, you can also borrow books!
Zhang Haoyu read the book for a while and was surprised to find that he had a photographic memory.
Is this because spiritual spring water and spiritual liquid transform the body? Or is it the effect of practicing the "Xuantian Immortality Technique"?
If you don’t understand it, stop thinking about it. Anyway, this is a good thing.
Zhang Haoyu used his spiritual consciousness to find the book he needed, and made a new discovery. All he had to do was focus his mental power on a book! Use your spiritual sense to scan and quickly store the entire book's knowledge in your mind!
Zhang Haoyu has repeatedly tested this ability several times, and it is simply amazing.
In one afternoon, I scanned all the books I needed with my spiritual consciousness and compiled the knowledgeStore it in your mind and digest it slowly!
In the next three days, Zhang Haoyu took his family to go fishing in the moat and the lake of Yihe Garden respectively, and also harvested many boxes from the moat and the lake of Yihe Garden!
